svg.title: The IBM data platform for AI in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Three of IBM’s figures: four engines in watsonx.data, Presto, Spark, OpenSearch and Cassandra; more than 60 data sources Cloud Pak for Data connects to; three ways to run watsonx.data, as SaaS, self-managed software or in your own cloud. Each figure is IBM’s, from its watsonx.data, Cloud Pak for Data and Netezza pages. IBM states no test conditions for them.
